The watchlist-curator agent was called weekly over the 2023-05-04 to 2026-05-01 window. Each rebalance is marked by an orange square on the curator curve in chart 1 — hover over one to see that rebalance's adds, removes, and the curator's rationale. The buy-and-hold portfolio has equal amounts of [AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA, SPY] and is held without any rebalancing across the window. Throughout the charts below: general_markets = defensive equity ETFs (broad-market / dividend / utilities / staples); cashlike = bonds + cash-equivalents + precious metals (e.g., AGG, BIL, IAU).
